summary: Marc Horan (46) died after a ~20-foot fall while climbing with family and friends in the Riviera area of Boulder Canyon; CPR by companions was unsuccessful and he was unresponsive when emergency services arrived; Boulder Emergency Squad, Rocky Mountain Rescue, Sunshine Fire District and AMR recovered the body.
notes: One-time Climbing.com 'Climbers We Lost' cross-check (2026-10-07); not previously indexed (no Horan row).
